title: Conversation about Electronic Talometer (Vol. I) — सुरभि / Surabhi (Doordarshan)

notes: Doordarshan magazine programme Surabhi, unedited U-matic low-band master, 24.04.1991, Hindi: a feature on the RADEL Talometer, a programmable Carnatic taala machine built by a computer engineer. Windows 1-2 the interview in a garden, 3 a bansuri played beside the machine's amplifier boxes, 4 the Talometer's front panel clicking the cycle alone, 5-6 the machine on its stand keeping taala under speech. Fetched over ncaa.gov.in's iOS HLS path (/vol2/.../<id>-IOS.m3u8 — an iPhone User-Agent is required or the segments 403/404); src is the repository record page.
